Contact support

Questions about OCR Scanner? Email chennoufo11@gmail.com. Include the app version, your Android version, your device model and a short description of what happened.

Never send passwords, private IDs or confidential documents. If a sample is needed, use a non-sensitive example and remove personal information.

Email support

Getting started

Choose Scan a document to use your camera app, or Import image or PDF to select a file. Add or reorder pages and use Crop and enhance if needed. Choose On-device, select your document language and tap Recognize document.

Use Text, Markdown or Formatted to review the result. Share text opens Android’s chooser. Export saves a TXT, Markdown or HTML file to a location you choose. TXT export is free; Markdown and HTML files require Pro.

Datalab cloud OCR

Datalab cloud OCR is in preparation and is not currently available. You can keep using the on-device engine. If the app shows that cloud setup is unavailable, select On-device for a draft before recognition starts.

When the service becomes available, choose Datalab, sign in with Google and confirm Send and recognize. The prepared pages are uploaded to our Cloudflare server and Datalab. Document languages are detected automatically. A failed cloud request does not silently switch to local OCR.

Cloud processing needs internet. If the connection is interrupted, keep the document and use Retry or Resume processing when offered. A sign-in error requires reconnecting your cloud account. Page and server usage limits apply even with Pro; Pro is not unlimited cloud processing. If a job has expired, keep the local pages and submit a new job when the service permits it.

Our server content expires 24 hours after job creation with scheduled cleanup. Physical cleanup may be delayed or retried. Datalab retention follows its own policy. See the cloud privacy details.

If recognition needs improvement

  • Keep the document flat and use bright, even lighting.
  • Use a sharp image with readable text; avoid glare and shadows.
  • Use manual crop and rotation to keep the page upright.
  • For on-device OCR, choose the matching document language from the 13 supported languages. Cloud OCR detects languages automatically when available.
  • Review every result. Handwriting, dense layouts and poor images can reduce accuracy.

File and processing problems

Use JPG, PNG, WebP or an unencrypted PDF. Free supports up to 3 pages per document; Pro supports up to 25 on-device or 10 with Datalab when available. Cloud usage limits also apply. Password-protected PDFs are not supported.

If a file cannot be opened, check that your chosen file provider has made it available on the phone. Try opening it in another application first, selecting it again or exporting a fresh copy from its source. Keep enough free device storage for copied pages and recognized text.

If processing stops, reopen the app and check the document status. For a repeated failure, contact support with the error message and device details.

Pro and restoring purchases

Open OCR Scanner Pro from the top bar or Settings. Free supports up to 3 pages per document and TXT export; Pro unlocks up to 25 pages on-device or 10 with Datalab when available, Markdown/HTML file exports and ad suppression. Cloud usage limits still apply. The purchase screen shows Galaxy Store’s local price when available.

Purchase and restore require internet, Galaxy Store and the same Samsung account used to buy Pro. Choose Restore purchases after reinstalling, clearing app storage or when a payment completes without unlocking Pro. Do not buy again before trying restore. A successful check with no owned purchase removes cached access; failed/offline checks preserve confirmed access.

If the price is unavailable, update Galaxy Store and install this app from the store. Pro cannot be purchased until the app and its product are available for your account and region. No payment is performed by this website.

Ads and privacy options

The current advertising mode is OFF: test and commercial ads are disabled through app configuration. Ads need internet. On-device scanning, editing and recognition work offline; cloud recognition needs internet. Document content is not sent with ad requests.

When available, open Settings → Ad privacy choices to review or change applicable advertising choices. If a consent message or ad cannot load, you can continue using the document features. Confirmed Pro access suppresses ads. If you already bought Pro and still see an ad, close the ad, restore purchases, then reopen the app.

Clear app storage to remove local documents, cached app settings and local privacy preferences. This does not delete Google’s advertising records or Samsung’s purchase records; use their own privacy controls for those requests. See the advertising disclosure.

Manage or delete your data

Open a document and choose Delete document to remove its saved pages and results from this device. Remove a draft page from its page card to delete only that page. Cloud account sign-out prevents future authenticated requests but does not erase earlier uploads.

Clearing storage in Android Settings or uninstalling removes all local app data. Keep your own copies first. Shared and exported files must be removed separately from the places you saved them.

Local deletion does not guarantee immediate deletion of cloud or Datalab copies. Our server content expires 24 hours after job creation, followed by scheduled cleanup that may be delayed. Minimal records for usage limits and duplicate requests are scheduled for removal 48 hours after that expiry. Datalab retention follows its own policy and applicable agreement.

We cannot restore offline files deleted from your device. For questions or requests about publisher-handled cloud job data or support correspondence, contact chennoufo11@gmail.com. Do not attach confidential documents.
